Enabled.Name: Show distance on hover
Enabled.Hint: Show the distance from your token when you hover over another token.

Mode.Name: Measure between
Mode.Hint: Nearest spaces matches D&D-style reach and range (adjacent tokens are 5 ft apart). Centers measures from the middle of each token.

Elevation.Name: Include elevation
Elevation.Hint: Count the height difference between tokens, including tokens on different levels.

Toggle.Name: Toggle hover distance
Toggle.Hint: Turn the hover distance label on or off.
